blogPosts.title: Preventing Blocked Drains in Your Burwood Home
blogPosts.excerpt: Practical tips to keep your drains clear and avoid costly blockages in Burwood properties, including seasonal advice.
body: Blocked drains are a common issue in Burwood homes, often caused by everyday habits that seem harmless. To prevent blockages, start by being mindful of what goes down your sinks and toilets. Avoid flushing wipes, sanitary products, and grease, as these can accumulate and cause clogs. In Burwood, where older homes may have narrower pipes, this caution is especially important.

Kitchen sinks are prone to grease buildup, so always scrape food waste into the bin before washing dishes. Use drain strainers to catch debris, and regularly flush drains with hot water and baking soda to dissolve minor blockages. In Burwood, where hard water can contribute to scale, this routine maintenance helps keep pipes clear.

Bathroom drains often get clogged with hair and soap scum. Install hair catchers in showers and baths, and clean them frequently. For Burwood residents, considering the local water quality, using enzymatic cleaners can break down organic matter without damaging pipes. We recommend avoiding chemical drain cleaners, as they can corrode pipes over time.

Outdoor drains in Burwood can be affected by leaves, dirt, and tree roots, especially during autumn and winter. Regularly clear gutters and drain covers, and ensure downspouts direct water away from your foundation. If you notice slow drainage, it might be a sign of root intrusion, which requires professional attention from Burwood plumbers.

Seasonal factors in Burwood, like heavy rains, can overwhelm drainage systems. Ensure your property has adequate stormwater management, such as properly graded surfaces and clear drains. Our team can inspect your system and recommend solutions like drain relining to prevent issues before they start.

Despite best efforts, blockages can still occur. When they do, avoid using plungers or chemicals excessively, as they might worsen the problem. Instead, contact Case Plumbing in Burwood for expert drain clearing services. We use CCTV cameras to locate blockages and high-pressure jetting to clear them efficiently.

In summary, preventing blocked drains in Burwood involves proactive maintenance and mindful habits. By following these tips and seeking professional help when needed, you can avoid costly repairs and keep your plumbing system running smoothly. Reach out to Case Plumbing for personalised advice and services in Burwood.
